requirements.requirement: The system must define a Pydantic model named SpecialtyMatchScore following existing patterns in provider_search_models.py.
The system must include a required field 'requested_specialty' as a non-empty string in the schema.
The system must include a field 'matched_nucc_codes' as a list of strings representing valid NUCC taxonomy codes.
The system must include a field 'match_confidence' as a float constrained between 0 and 1 inclusive.
The system must include a field 'explanation_metadata' as a structured object containing scoring rationale attributes.
The system must ensure the schema is JSON serializable and compatible with existing provider evaluation response formats.
The system must accept NUCC taxonomy outputs from specialty_service.py without transformation errors.
The system must validate that 'matched_nucc_codes' contains only strings matching NUCC code format patterns.
The system must default 'matched_nucc_codes' to an empty list when no matches are found.
The system must default 'match_confidence' to 0.0 when no valid specialty match exists.
The system must include explanation_metadata fields that support LLM-readable reasoning, including match_type and contributing_terms.
The system must ensure explanation_metadata is structured to allow downstream natural language generation without additional parsing.
The system must raise a validation error if 'match_confidence' is outside the range [0,1].
The system must raise a validation error if 'requested_specialty' is null or empty.
The system must allow extension of explanation_metadata with additional fields without breaking backward compatibility.
